main.description: Photos of the trail reports the viewer may see (as app.activitytracker.feed.getTrailReports lists them) on one segment, or on every segment of one trail or road, newest first, a report's photos in its order.

segment.description: One segment. Exactly one of segment and path.

path.description: A trail or road (app.activitytracker.feed.path): the photos on every segment it lists.
